description: Tara (Dina / birth-star) koota — health, longevity and fortune compatibility from counting between the two janma nakshatras. Computed in BOTH directions and combined.

counting_rule.description: Count nakshatras inclusively from the FROM partner's janma nakshatra to the TO partner's janma nakshatra, moving forward through the 27-nakshatra cycle. Divide the inclusive count by 9. The remainder maps to a tara; remainder 0 is treated as tara 9.
counting_rule.formula_note: inclusive_count = ((to_index - from_index) mod 27) + 1 ; remainder = inclusive_count mod 9 ; tara = remainder==0 ? 9 : remainder

scoring.combine_rule: Evaluate auspiciousness of the tara in each direction. Both auspicious -> 3; exactly one auspicious -> 1.5; neither auspicious -> 0.

notes: Auspicious taras: Sampat(2), Kshema(4), Sadhaka(6), Mitra(8), Ati-Mitra(9). Inauspicious: Janma(1), Vipat(3), Pratyak(5), Vadha/Naidhana(7).
Some schools count from the bride's star only and score out of 3 in a single direction; this pack uses the bidirectional-combine convention. review_required to confirm the school's convention (OQ-2).
